a_wants: auto-approve clean files so turnaround falls
b_wants: a human decision recorded on every file
where_it_collides: the fastest version of the COO's number removes the auditor's condition
how_it_is_handled: the skeleton has a human approve every file; the question goes on the readout agenda
decided_by: the compliance head on the auditor's behalf; the COO cannot overrule

where_it_collides: speed against error rate; the trade-off at the centre of the engagement
how_it_is_handled: the compliance head sets the acceptable error rate; the COO's number is measured inside it

a_wants: fewer hours per file and no added step
where_it_collides: a review step on every file cuts turnaround but can add analyst hours
how_it_is_handled: hours per file is a first-class metric next to turnaround; the tool reads the tracker before replacing it
decided_by: the COO with the team leads

a_wants: every call inside the 6 pm batch window
where_it_collides: the batch bounds how fast any file can move; three days cannot start before the file arrives
how_it_is_handled: the batch window is a constraint in step 1; same-hour intake is out of scope

a_wants: no customer PII near a vendor system until the review passes
where_it_collides: the skeleton needs real scans; the review takes eight weeks
how_it_is_handled: masked files approved by the compliance head on-prem for the skeleton; the questionnaire starts in week 2

a_wants: files sent back only with a reason
where_it_collides: each side believes the other causes the 31 percent
how_it_is_handled: day-one completeness feedback with the rule that fired; the blame becomes a rule
decided_by: the compliance head (she signs the rules)
